rationale: Same root cause as RAW-005. Severity DOWNGRADED from econ-scanner's tentative Medium to Low: the project's own test `test_migrateMint_runsWhenPaused` at test/V2/BalancerPoolerV2.t.sol:1732 explicitly asserts migration executes after pause. The pause-bypass is the INTENDED design — migrations are a one-shot exit path that should keep working when the rest of the protocol is paused. This is a documentation / runbook gap, not a security gap. The residual risk (id-4 holders continuing to convert during an id-4-related incident) is bounded by id-4 supply (1:1) and mitigable by owner revocation of authorizedBurner/authorizedMinter.
